reference: ∀ {n : ℕ+} {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {x : G},   orderOf x = ↑n →     G = ↥(Subgroup.closure {x}) →       ∀ (H : Subgroup G),         (∃ (p : ℕ), Prime p ∧ p ∣ ↑n ∧ H = Subgroup.closure {x ^ p}) ↔ H ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ (K : Subgroup G), H ≤ K → K = H ∨ K = ⊤
lean: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {x : G} {n : ℕ},   x ^ n = 1 →     ∀ (H : Subgroup G),       (∃ (k : ℕ), k ∣ n ∧ H = Subgroup.closure {x ^ k} ∧ ∀ (N : Subgroup G), H ≤ N → N = ⊤ ∨ N = H) ↔         ∃ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ n ∧ H = Subgroup.closure {x ^ (n / p)}
